# Dominion Fortress

> Dominion Fortress provides cybersecurity, technology, AI, IT, software, data, digital growth, finance, and consulting services for organizations.

## Primary focus
- Cybersecurity: authorized penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, external attack surface assessment, red team testing, security monitoring, incident response.
- AI & Automation: AI strategy, workflow automation, AI agents, LLM integrations, RAG, and AI security/governance.
- IT & Cloud: cloud infrastructure, migration, networking, managed IT, DevOps, and automation.
- Software Development: web applications, APIs, SaaS, mobile applications, backend and full-stack engineering.
- Data & Analytics: data engineering, analytics, business intelligence, machine learning, and reporting.
- Digital Growth: SEO, technical SEO, AEO, GEO/AI-search visibility, content, CRO, and digital marketing.
- Finance & Accounting: bookkeeping, financial analysis, FP&A, financial reporting, modeling, and advisory services.
- Consulting: technology strategy, digital transformation, automation, operations, and technology advisory.

## Security principles
All cybersecurity assessments require appropriate client authorization and defined scope. An external security exposure review is an initial visibility assessment, not a penetration test.
